Mosaic (MOS) Bets On Enzymes While Its Core Business Bleeds
summary: On August 17, Mosaic Biosciences, a unit of The Mosaic Company (NYSE:MOS), launched Renuvis Enzara, an enzyme-based treatment meant to speed up how fast crop residue breaks down after harvest.
